DIV5.HEAD: PART 391 - QUALIFICATIONS OF DRIVERS AND LONGER COMBINATION VEHICLE (LCV) DRIVER INSTRUCTORS

DIV8.HEAD: 391.11 General qualifications of drivers.
DIV8.P: A person shall not drive a commercial motor vehicle unless he/she is qualified to drive a commercial motor vehicle.
A motor carrier shall not require or permit a person to drive a commercial motor vehicle unless that person is qualified to drive a commercial motor vehicle.

Except as provided in subpart G of this part, a person is qualified to drive a motor vehicle if he/she is in possession of a valid commercial motor vehicle operator's license issued by only one State or jurisdiction.
DIV8.CITA: [35 FR 6458, Apr. 22, 1970, as amended at 55 FR 12271, April 2, 1990]

DIV8.HEAD: 391.15 Disqualification of drivers.
DIV8.P: A driver who is disqualified must not drive a commercial motor vehicle.
A motor carrier must not permit a disqualified driver to drive a commercial motor vehicle.

DIV5.HEAD: PART 393 - PARTS AND ACCESSORIES NECESSARY FOR SAFE OPERATION

DIV6.HEAD: Subpart C - Lighting Devices, Reflectors, and Electrical Equipment

DIV8.HEAD: 393.9 Lamps operable.
DIV8.P: Every lamp and reflective device required by this subpart must be maintained in good operating condition.
A motor carrier shall inspect all required lamps before each trip to ensure they are operable.
